name: Repeater2Template Widget for ACF Repeater and Elementor
author: slickwebdeveloper

sections.description:
This plugin enables you to loop through ACF Repeater fields or a JSON array and render each row using an Elementor Template. It gives full control over how repeater or JSON data is displayed and supports subfield mapping to dynamic tags.

Key Features:

  • Select any ACF Pro Repeater field or provide a JSON array as a data source.
  • Choose an Elementor Pro template to render each row.
  • Define subfield-to-dynamic-tag mappings.
  • Supports text, image, URL, and media fields.
  • No code required — flexible and extendable.
  • Lightweight and Elementor-native experience.

JSON Array Support:

You can now pass a JSON array as a data source instead of an ACF Repeater. Each JSON object should contain keys corresponding to the mapped dynamic tags in your Elementor template.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the WordPress admin panel.

  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.

  3. Make sure you have Elementor Pro and Advanced Custom Fields Pro (ACF Pro) installed and activated if using ACF data source.

  4. Create a Repeater field using ACF Pro and add data to a post/page, or prepare a JSON array for your data source.

  5. Create an Elementor Pro template to use for rendering.

  6. Add the Repeater2Template For ACF Repeater to your Elementor layout and configure settings, selecting either an ACF Repeater or JSON as the data source.
sections.faq:
Does it support ACF Pro only?

No. You can use an ACF Repeater (requires ACF Pro) or a JSON array.

Can I use this with Elementor Free?

No. Elementor Pro is required for dynamic tag support and template integration.

Where do I create the template?

Go to Templates > Saved Templates in Elementor, and design your layout using dynamic tags with your mapped keys.

What kind of fields are supported?

Text, URL, images, and media (with URL fallback if necessary).

Why does this plugin require ACF Pro and Elementor Pro?

ACF Repeater field is available only in ACF Pro. Elementor Pro is required to use dynamic tags and saved templates, which are essential for how this plugin works. JSON array support works without ACF Pro.
